name: Sheoldred, Whispering One
description: A Phyrexian who believes many worlds will bow to Phyrexia.

description_citations.text: Commander Legends: card flavor text (Commander Legends, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred states Mirrodin is merely the first world to bow to Phyrexia.

citation.text: Phyrexian Rager (Eternal Masters, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred teaches that pain is a sign of imperfection.
timeline.quote: "Pain isn't a negative stimulus. Pain is a sign of your imperfection."

citation.text: Pierce Strider (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred predicts that many worlds will bow to Phyrexia, with Mirrodin first.
timeline.quote: "I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."

citation.text: Phyrexian Rager (Commander Legends, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
